description: POST titles as JSON {"titles": [...]} or as raw text with one title per line, and get back URL-safe slugs. Strips accents, lowercases, removes apostrophes and collapses other punctuation to single hyphens. Up to 500 titles per call. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/slugify.
name: slugify
